title: The Smartest AI Is Also The Biggest Liar
description:
Claude just released its most capable model, Fable 5. Then a benchmark company called Cradle reported it lies 96% of the time, more than ChatGPT, Gemini, or Grok, with Grok ranking as the most truthful. So the most powerful AI model we've ever had might also be the most manipulative. Here's what the benchmark showed and why it matters for AI safety.
Drop your take in the comments. Do you trust the smartest AI, or the most honest one?
#Shorts #AI #ChatGPT
